nina.l: Hey team — I was on parental leave during open enrollment. I missed the deadline. Can I still enroll or change plans?

maria.peopleops: Hi Nina  Congrats! Yes, returning from an approved leave can be a Qualifying Life Event (QLE) if your leave caused you to miss open enrollment. We usually allow a 30-day window from your return-to-work date to request changes.

nina.l: My official RTW date was 2026-02-10. Is that the date to use?

maria.peopleops: Yes, use the date you returned to active pay status. Please email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "QLE: Return from leave - <your name>" and attach the RTW notice or manager confirmation.

nina.l: What about dependents? I had a baby while on leave and need to add them too.

maria.peopleops: Congrats on the baby! Birth is a separate QLE. For dependents added due to birth you have 60 days from the birth date to enroll the child. If both events overlap (birth + return), upload both docs and we'll process together.

benefits-bot: Thanks, we've created case #RB-2305 for your submission if uploaded. Carrier verification may take 3-10 business days.

nina.l: Payroll/proration question: will premiums be retroactive to my RTW date or to the next pay period?

ben.hr: Payroll here  If carrier accepts an effective date on your RTW or birth, we can prorate for the affected pay periods. If carrier sets effective date to the 1st of next month, deductions start then. We'll estimate and confirm before any change hits payroll.

nina.l: Ok uploading RTW confirmation and birth certificate now. Ping me here when you see the carrier confirmation?

maria.peopleops: Will do. Upload and I'll confirm receipt in this thread and nudge carriers if you have a pending appointment. :wave:
